create_rpc_client_and_host: create an moolib.Rpc client and host to communicate over TCP at 127.0.0.1:4411
define_rpc_function: define a named function on an moolib.Rpc host using the define method
sync_rpc_call: call a remote function synchronously using client.sync with the host name and method
async_rpc_call: call a remote function asynchronously using client.async_ and collect results via Future.result
async_callback_rpc_call: call a remote function with a callback using client.async_callback for response handling
